observations: Upright freezer with top lid open in photo 0; interior shows frost/ice and a drain/cover area.
Branding sticker visible on front door in photo 1: “Haire” and “THERMOCOOL” (also a “5 years warranty” style badge).
Photo 2 shows rear/side with condenser/coil area and a visible wire/guard; dust/possible wear around the base/coil area.
No clear model number or exact capacity (liters) readable from the photos provided.

claims.claim: Classic and reliable themocool freezer with a string capacity long lasting freezing for up to five...
claims.evidence: Photos show ThermoCool branding (photo 1) but do not show the exact capacity or what “up to five” refers to in readable form.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: No receipt/date or warranty card is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos do not confirm motor/compressor condition or whether it has been opened.
No receipt or warranty card is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: “I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true. Please check again.”
claims.evidence: No new photos/videos were provided to verify the test result (e.g., temperature readings, compressor running, or any measurement).

risks.risk: Capacity/model mismatch: exact ThermoCool model and liters are not readable, which affects market price.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating plate/model label showing model number and capacity (liters).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic ThermoCool upright freezer of unknown capacity (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Cooling performance not proven remotely: frost/ice in photo 0 could be normal, but it may not hold temperature reliably.
risks.proof: Video of it running with a thermometer reading inside after 30–60 minutes (or a temperature log).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven (worst-case treated as needs testing/service).

risks.risk: Electrical/starting/compressor health not confirmable from photos.
risks.proof: Short clip showing compressor start and stable operation (no unusual noise/smell) plus power draw if possible.

risks.risk: Condition/wear: visible dust/possible wear around base/coil area (photo 2) could indicate poor maintenance or age beyond “barely used.”
risks.proof: Close-up photos of base/coil area plus any rust/leaks; confirm interior drain area condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with maintenance needs (worst-case).

risks.risk: Lid seal/gasket condition: poor sealing reduces freezing efficiency and increases power use.
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the lid gasket around the full perimeter and a simple seal test (paper strip test).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the rating plate/model label (model number + capacity in liters).
Send a short video of the freezer running (compressor on) and show a thermometer inside after 30–60 minutes.
Send photos of the warranty card and receipt (showing purchase date).
Send close-up photos of the lid gasket all around and the interior drain area.
Send a close-up of the rear/coil area and confirm no leaks/rust; ideally include a running-clip to check for abnormal noise/overheating.
response.reason: The seller’s claim of testing is not verifiable without new evidence. The key items that determine price—exact model/capacity and confirmed cooling performance—are still not proven by the photos provided, so pricing would be guesswork.
